For the 19Al alloy the α→β-Mn transformation was only completed after 10 h of aging at 550 °C, so the 550 °C / 3 h sample remains in a partially transformed state; 17Al required only 6 h at 550 °C (b0053, b0065).

The precipitation kinetics of β-Mn decreased with increasing Al content, attributed to Al enrichment around β-Mn hindering its growth and to the stabilizing effect of Al on the Al-rich D0₃ phase (b0065).
